summary: Bataan 3rd District representative with 68 principal-authored bills. Only additional court branches and a universal health care devolution bill surfaced under rubric topics. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
